name: Magneticdramon
main_effect:
＜Fragment (3)＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, by trashing any 3 of its digivolution cards, it isn't deleted.)
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] By trashing 3 [Mineral] or [Rock] trait cards from any of your Digimon's digivolution cards, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon and trash their top security card.
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By placing 3 [Mineral] or [Rock] trait cards from your trash as this Digimon's bottom digivolution cards, it unsuspends.
